name: chapeng_environment
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished environment background for the 960x540 internal resolution of a Chinese wuxia ARPG. Same art style as the attached approved mountain-temple master image: rustic 16-bit era pixel art, clean chunky square pixels, top-down 3/4 camera tilted about 45 degrees, orthographic view, no vanishing point, NOT 30-degree isometric. The reference is STYLE AND MATERIALS only; create a new roadside tea-shed location, do not copy its gate courtyard or monk. Primary scene from the brief: a roadside tea shed on a mountain path, a thatched open shed with EXACTLY TWO rough wooden tables and simple benches, a clay stove with a visible kettle, a short bamboo fence, a broad dirt path winding up into pine trees, and far up the path a small gray-tiled temple roof. Daytime, calm soft daylight atmosphere but hard two-step pixel shading, upper-left illumination and shadows to lower right. Materials: dusk-warm ochre earth #C9A66B, gray-green stone #6E6A5E, dark wood #3B2A20, pine green #4C6B55 and night-blue deepest shade #1C2233. Restrained low-saturation environment, no jewel-bright colors or magic. Composition as a practical single-screen game map, landscape exact 16:9: the open thatched tea shelter and its two tables occupy the upper-left third, with the kettle on its clay stove clearly visible beside the shelter, not hidden behind a roof; bamboo fencing follows the left/back edge. A wide flat playable dirt clearing occupies the center and lower middle with unobstructed space for two 40-pixel-high game characters to talk and move. The path connects the bottom-center edge through this clearing toward the upper-right edge and temple roof beyond the upper trees. Keep consistent object scale across the map, no shrinking ground grid or cinematic horizon, no vista of sky. Pine trees and rocks frame the far edges, do not fill the central clearing. A simple cleanly readable straw roof silhouette will be extracted later as a foreground occlusion layer, so keep the shelter compact, canopy outline clear and separate from the pine canopy. No signs unless completely blank. Absolutely NO PEOPLE, no monk, no silhouettes, no animals, no blood letter, no written characters, no letters, labels, UI, text, watermark, logo, modern objects, Japanese elements or fantasy shrine. No fog, bloom, gradients, antialiasing, blur, photographic detail or 3D. The final asset is native 960x540 with max48 colors; if working larger use a clean integer magnification of that grid and preserve broad square pixel clusters. Return ONE complete opaque background, no frames or image border.

name: stove_material_correction
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached roadside tea-shed background. Make ONE very small material correction only: replace the visibly pale gray block-stone stove at the far LEFT, under the existing black kettle (roughly x=120..285, y=310..417 in this 1672x941 image), with a compact rustic EARTHEN CLAY STOVE, hand-shaped rounded shoulders and dull ochre-brown clay/mud surface. Keep the same small footprint, position, top height, front fire opening and tiny warm ember glow. The kettle must remain exactly the same kettle, size and position, resting on the earthen stove. Its supporting stones can stay only at ground level, not a block-stone body. No new objects, no text, no people. Everything else must remain unchanged: two rough dining tables, benches, roof outline and straw details, bamboo fence, path, temple roof, pines, rocks, colors, lighting, camera, 16-bit hard pixel-art style and exact wide framing. Do not relight the scene or recompose anything. Keep the original 1672x941 canvas if possible. Correct only that small stove material area, no gradient, glow, antialiasing or photographic texture.
